title: Show agency monthly original-currency subtotals in report designer
description: A customer-service user sees the registered, draft and void original-currency subtotals alongside current-page group counts in the agency monthly report designer. Consume ERP-186 server-provided group amounts rather than calculating from visible columns; preserve month or customer labels, currency precision, field selection, filters and bounded paging. Display explicit page-only evidence, no-proration and truncated context so users do not mistake values for receivables or revenue; show visible empty, unauthorized, validation and network states. Preview remains read-only and OperationLogMiddleware records calls. Development only: no schema or migration edits, production SQL or real database execution, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets, deployment or browser acceptance. Use temporary locations for manual test output and verify focused UI contract tests plus safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: The designer displays ERP-186 server-provided original-currency registered, draft and void amount subtotals beside ERP-185 current-page group counts, even when amount or dimension columns are not selected.
Group labels, currency precision, page-only and truncated evidence notices remain clear; mixed currencies stay separate and no cross-page or receivable/revenue total is shown.
Focused UI contract tests cover field selection, mixed currencies, status amount separation, empty and truncated pages, unauthorized and network errors; safe Release build/test passes.
